note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `hasCriticalFinding` covers only distant metastasis and a progressive metabolic treatment response — a high SUVmax (>= 10) is its own dedicated major-severity trigger (R-SEV-MAJOR-02), entirely independent of `hasCriticalFinding`, so an intensely avid primary lesion with no nodal or distant spread grades major severity but escalates only to 'urgent' follow-up, not 'critical-alert'.

personas.name: normal-fdg-pet-ct-complete-response-complete
personas.description: An interval FDG PET-CT for post-treatment Hodgkin lymphoma surveillance: no abnormal FDG-avid lesion, physiological tracer distribution only, complete metabolic response maintained, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.clinicalHistory: Post-treatment surveillance for Hodgkin lymphoma, previously in complete remission; interval FDG PET-CT.

state.comparisonWithPrevious: Compared with the prior post-treatment PET-CT 6 months ago, also showing no abnormal uptake.
state.impression: No FDG-avid disease; complete metabolic response maintained.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Continue routine surveillance per the lymphoma follow-up pathway.

personas.name: abnormal-high-avidity-lung-primary-major-not-critical-complete
personas.description: A staging FDG PET-CT for newly diagnosed non-small-cell lung cancer shows an intensely FDG-avid right upper lobe mass (28mm, SUVmax 12.5) with no nodal or distant metastatic disease: SUVmax >= 10 is a dedicated major-severity trigger (R-SEV-MAJOR-02) entirely independent of `hasCriticalFinding` (distant metastasis or progressive disease only), so this grades major severity but escalates only to 'urgent' follow-up, never critical-alert; report complete — expect abnormal classification + major severity (reportingCategory high-avidity) + 100% completeness + urgent follow-up + specialist-referral.

state.clinicalHistory: Newly diagnosed non-small-cell lung cancer; staging FDG PET-CT.
state.findingsNarrative: An intensely FDG-avid spiculated mass is seen in the right upper lobe, measuring 28mm, with SUVmax 12.5. No FDG-avid mediastinal or hilar nodal uptake. No evidence of distant metastatic disease.
state.impression: Highly FDG-avid right upper lobe mass (SUVmax 12.5), consistent with the known non-small-cell lung cancer. No nodal or distant metastatic disease identified on this study.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Discuss at the lung cancer MDT for staging confirmation and treatment planning.

expected.recommendedAction: Arrange urgent clinical review and expedite onward oncology referral.
